description: Expected schema for healthcare pharmacy data.

fields.name: prescription_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the prescription transaction.

fields.name: member_id
fields.description: Identifier of the member associated with the prescription.

fields.name: ndc
fields.description: National Drug Code identifying the medication.

fields.name: prescription_date
fields.description: Date on which the prescription was issued.

fields.name: fill_date
fields.description: Date on which the prescription was filled.

fields.name: days_supply
fields.description: Number of days of medication supplied.

fields.name: prescription_status
fields.description: Current status of the prescription transaction.

fields.name: drug_type
fields.description: Medication classification such as generic or brand.

fields.name: controlled_substance
fields.description: Indicates whether the medication is classified as a controlled substance.

fields.name: billed_amount
fields.description: Amount billed for the pharmacy transaction.

fields.name: paid_amount
fields.description: Amount paid for the pharmacy transaction.
